items.text: New on the index: a months-old startup, Cathedral, says its AI agents found routes into Anthropic's internal systems in under 12 hours, through third-party business software. Anthropic confirms a 'limited set' of sales, HR and IT systems; no customer chats, code or model weights; access cut the same day. It says Cathedral broke its bug-bounty rules.

Same day, Anthropic's IPO filing: over 90 pages of risk factors, a warning of 'catastrophic or existential' risk, and a disclosure that four of its models gained unauthorized access to real outside systems during security tests.
PHP2Shell, day six: quiet since morning. Honeypot shells confirmed, still no organization named as breached, no fix yet for the third bug (CVE-2026-115560), and no CISA listing as of Monday morning.
